description: This file defines a Java interface 'BulkImportWorkbookService' related to bulk import functionalities within the Fineract project. It declares methods for importing workbooks, retrieving import data, and handling output templates.

classes.name: BulkImportWorkbookService
classes.description: A Java interface defining methods for bulk import operations such as importing workbooks, retrieving import data, and managing import output templates.

methods.name: importWorkbook
methods.description: Imports a workbook given entity type, input stream, file details, locale, and date format.

methods.name: getImports
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of import data for a given entity type.

methods.name: getOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Gets the document data containing the location of the output template for a specified import document ID.

methods.name: getOutputTemplate
methods.description: Returns a Response containing the output template for a specified import document ID.
